sources.title: GitHub - meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video · GitHub
sources.snippet: We introduce LongCat-Video, a foundational video generation model with 13.6B parameters, delivering strong performance across Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and Video-Continuation generation tasks. It particularly excels in efficient and high-quality long video generation, representing our first step toward world models.
